notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug that click sounds were not played in the Encyclopedia after reloading a game

notes.title: Costs for Pipes and Walkways
notes.content:
This update introduces costs for Pipes and Walkways. Each element costs 1t of Silicates.

Added further entries to the encyclopedia, some minor UI improvements and bugfixes.

notes.title: Bugfixes and new Sound Effects
notes.content: Fixed a few bugs and added new sound effects when clicking on Telescope or Plastic Production buildings

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content: Fixed bugs with the newly introduced astronauts

notes.title: Sound Effects
notes.content:
This build adds many sound effects to the game. Not all buildings and events have a dedicated sound effect yet, but this should change in the future. Please share your feedback!

Additionally, a few other bugs were fixed:
[list]
[*]The game can now be saved while paused
[*]A few bugs in the intro were fixed, including that the arrows were not pointing at their targets accurately
[*]A few other minor issues
[/list]

notes.title: Small screen optimizations
notes.content:
The graphical user interface has been adjusted to fit better on smaller screen sizes, such as laptops.
Fixed bloom effects of bright lights.
